description: Starter Superset dashboard spec for Quant Team OS strategy, backtest, factor, and risk aggregate analytics.

charts.name: Strategies by Status
charts.query: select current_status, count(*) as strategy_count from strategy_cards group by current_status order by strategy_count desc

charts.name: Backtest Runs by Status
charts.query: select status, count(*) as backtest_count from backtest_runs group by status order by backtest_count desc

charts.name: Risk Review Verdicts
charts.query: select verdict, count(*) as review_count from risk_reviews group by verdict order by review_count desc

charts.name: Factor Specs by Status
charts.query: select status, count(*) as factor_count from factor_specs group by status order by factor_count desc
